prompt: drum n bass, dufry, fred again
title: Vowel Letter, Liquid
description: A liquid Fred-again-style formant lead: a sawtooth sings stepped vowels (a-e-i-o) over a slow triangle band-pass journey while a saw LFO opens the low-pass, with breathing vibrato that deepens and fades. A short delay and a kept-in-check room give it a wet, vocal-but-present tail that morphs across 32 cycles.
code:
setcpm(174/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 [c4 d4] f4 eb4>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o>/3")
    .vib(tri.slow(13).range(3.5, 6.5)).vibmod(saw.slow(23).range(0.12, 0.55))
    .bpf(tri.slow(29).range(520, 2100)).bpq("<5 8 6 10>/4")
    .lpf(saw.slow(16).range(900, 4200)).resonance("<7 11 9 13>/8")
    .lpenv("<3 5 2 6>/4").lpattack(0.02).lpdecay(0.18).lpsustain(0.5)
    .attack(0.03).decay(0.2).sustain(0.7).release(0.12)
    .shape("<0.12 0.2 0.16 0.24>/8")
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.32, 0.68))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.4).vowel("<e i o a>/3"))
    .delay("0.32:0.375:0.45").delaytime(0.375)
    .room(0.34).roomsize(3)
    .gain(0.88)
)
